title: Explain note-only matches in the core next search catalog
outcome: A caller using the core next search catalog can understand why an item matched through note or gate text.
acceptance: The core next --search behavior is documented as including canonical note and gate matches, or its catalog rows carry a bounded locator/family explanation for those matches.

A regression verifies that a note-only matching item remains discoverable through core next search, with explanation or documented route to the matching locator, while existing scope and receipt bounds remain intact.

completion.summary: Document core catalog note/gate search matching and the listing/show route to its matching locator; add regression coverage for note-only and gate-only discovery, project scope, receipt bounds and unchanged focus/delivery.
